   323|/-- The fixed point lemma for normal functions: any normal function has an unbounded set of
   324|fixed points. -/
   325|theorem not_bddAbove_fp (H : IsNormal f) : ¬ BddAbove (Function.fixedPoints f) := by
   326|  convert not_bddAbove_fp_family fun _ : Unit => H
   327|  exact (Set.iInter_const _).symm

   329|/-- The derivative of a normal function `f` is the sequence of fixed points of `f`.
   330|
   331|This is defined as `Ordinal.derivFamily` applied to a trivial family consisting only of `f`. -/
   332|def deriv (f : Ordinal → Ordinal) : Ordinal → Ordinal :=
   333|  derivFamily fun _ : Unit => f
   334|
   335|theorem deriv_eq_derivFamily (f : Ordinal → Ordinal) : deriv f = derivFamily fun _ : Unit => f :=
   336|  rfl
   337|
   338|@[simp]
   339|theorem deriv_zero_right (f) : deriv f 0 = nfp f 0 :=
   340|  derivFamily_zero _
   341|
   342|@[simp]
   343|theorem deriv_succ (f o) : deriv f (succ o) = nfp f (succ (deriv f o)) :=
   344|  derivFamily_succ _ _
   345|
   346|theorem deriv_limit (f) {o} : IsSuccLimit o → deriv f o = ⨆ a : {a // a < o}, deriv f a :=
   347|  derivFamily_limit _
   348|
   349|theorem isNormal_deriv (f) : IsNormal (deriv f) :=
   350|  isNormal_derivFamily _
   351|
   352|theorem deriv_strictMono (f) : StrictMono (deriv f) :=
   353|  derivFamily_strictMono _
   354|
   355|theorem deriv_eq_id_of_nfp_eq_id (h : nfp f = id) : deriv f = id :=
   356|  ((isNormal_deriv _).ext .id).2 (by simp [h])
   357|
   358|@[deprecated (since := "2025-10-25")]
   359|alias deriv_id_of_nfp_id := deriv_eq_id_of_nfp_eq_id
   360|
   361|theorem deriv_fp (H : IsNormal f) : ∀ o, f (deriv f o) = deriv f o :=
   362|  derivFamily_fp (i := ⟨⟩) H

   364|@[deprecated (since := "2025-10-25")]
   365|alias IsNormal.deriv_fp := deriv_fp

   367|theorem le_iff_deriv (H : IsNormal f) {a} : f a ≤ a ↔ ∃ o, deriv f o = a := by
   368|  unfold deriv
   369|  rw [← le_iff_derivFamily fun _ : Unit => H]
   370|  exact ⟨fun h _ => h, fun h => h Unit.unit⟩
   371|
   372|@[deprecated (since := "2025-10-25")]
   373|alias IsNormal.le_iff_deriv := le_iff_deriv

   375|theorem mem_range_deriv (H : IsNormal f) {a} : a ∈ Set.range (deriv f) ↔ f a = a := by
   376|  rw [Set.mem_range, ← H.strictMono.le_apply.ge_iff_eq', le_iff_deriv H]

   379|theorem fp_iff_deriv (H : IsNormal f) {a} : f a = a ↔ ∃ o, deriv f o = a :=
   380|  (mem_range_deriv H).symm

   383|alias IsNormal.fp_iff_deriv := fp_iff_deriv

   385|/-- `Ordinal.deriv` enumerates the fixed points of a normal function. -/
   386|theorem deriv_eq_enumOrd (H : IsNormal f) : deriv f = enumOrd (Function.fixedPoints f) := by
   387|  convert derivFamily_eq_enumOrd fun _ : Unit => H
   388|  exact (Set.iInter_const _).symm

   390|theorem nfp_zero_left (a) : nfp 0 a = a := by
   391|  rw [← iSup_iterate_eq_nfp]
   392|  apply (Ordinal.iSup_le ?_).antisymm (Ordinal.le_iSup _ 0)
   393|  intro n
   394|  cases n
   395|  · rfl
   396|  · rw [Function.iterate_succ']
   397|    simp
   398|
   399|@[simp]
   400|theorem nfp_zero : nfp 0 = id := by
   401|  ext
   402|  exact nfp_zero_left _
   403|
   404|@[simp]
   405|theorem deriv_zero : deriv 0 = id :=
   406|  deriv_eq_id_of_nfp_eq_id nfp_zero
   407|
   408|theorem deriv_zero_left (a) : deriv 0 a = a := by
   409|  rw [deriv_zero, id_eq]
   410|
   411|end

   413|/-! ### Fixed points of addition -/
   414|
   415|@[simp]
   416|theorem nfp_add_zero (a) : nfp (a + ·) 0 = a * ω := by
   417|  simp_rw [← iSup_iterate_eq_nfp, ← iSup_mul_natCast]
   418|  congr; funext n
   419|  induction n with
   420|  | zero => rw [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, iterate_zero_apply]
   421|  | succ n hn => rw [iterate_succ_apply', Nat.add_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one_add, hn]
   422|
   423|theorem nfp_add_eq_mul_omega0 {a b} (hba : b ≤ a * ω) : nfp (a + ·) b = a * ω := by
   424|  apply le_antisymm (nfp_le_fp (isNormal_add_right a).monotone hba _)
   425|  · rw [← nfp_add_zero]
   426|    exact nfp_monotone (isNormal_add_right a).monotone (zero_le b)
   427|  · dsimp; rw [← mul_one_add, one_add_omega0]
   428|
   429|theorem add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le {a b : Ordinal} : a + b = b ↔ a * ω ≤ b := by
   430|  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
   431|  · rw [← nfp_add_zero a, ← deriv_zero_right]
   432|    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_range_deriv (isNormal_add_right a)).2 h
   433|    rw [← hc]
   434|    exact (isNormal_deriv _).monotone (zero_le _)
   435|  · have := Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h
   436|    nth_rw 1 [← this]
   437|    rwa [← add_assoc, ← mul_one_add, one_add_omega0]
   438|
   439|theorem add_le_right_iff_mul_omega0_le {a b : Ordinal} : a + b ≤ b ↔ a * ω ≤ b := by
   440|  rw [← add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le]
   441|  exact (isNormal_add_right a).strictMono.le_apply.ge_iff_eq'
   442|
   443|theorem deriv_add_eq_mul_omega0_add (a b : Ordinal.{u}) : deriv (a + ·) b = a * ω + b := by
   444|  revert b
   445|  rw [← funext_iff, IsNormal.ext (isNormal_deriv _) (isNormal_add_right _)]
   446|  refine ⟨?_, fun a h => ?_⟩
   447|  · rw [bot_eq_zero, deriv_zero_right, add_zero]
   448|    exact nfp_add_zero a
   449|  · rw [deriv_succ, h, add_succ]
   450|    exact nfp_eq_self (add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le.2 (le_self_add.trans (le_succ _)))
   451|
   452|/-! ### Fixed points of multiplication -/
   453|
   454|@[simp]
   455|theorem nfp_mul_one {a : Ordinal} (ha : 0 < a) : nfp (a * ·) 1 = a ^ ω := by
   456|  rw [← iSup_iterate_eq_nfp, ← iSup_pow_natCast ha]
   457|  congr
   458|  funext n
   459|  induction n with
   460|  | zero => rw [pow_zero, iterate_zero_apply]
   461|  | succ n hn => rw [iterate_succ_apply', Nat.add_comm, pow_add, pow_one, hn]
   462|
   463|@[simp]
   464|theorem nfp_mul_zero (a : Ordinal) : nfp (a * ·) 0 = 0 := by
   465|  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, nfp_le_iff]
   466|  intro n
   467|  induction n with
   468|  | zero => rfl
   469|  | succ n hn => dsimp only; rwa [iterate_succ_apply, mul_zero]
   470|
   471|theorem nfp_mul_eq_opow_omega0 {a b : Ordinal} (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b ≤ a ^ ω) :
   472|    nfp (a * ·) b = a ^ ω := by
   473|  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
   474|  · rw [ha, zero_opow omega0_ne_zero] at hba ⊢
   475|    simp_rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 hba, zero_mul]
   476|    exact nfp_zero_left 0
   477|  apply le_antisymm
   478|  · apply nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone hba
   479|    rw [← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]
   480|  rw [← nfp_mul_one ha]
   481|  exact nfp_monotone (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone (one_le_iff_pos.2 hb)
   482|
   483|theorem eq_zero_or_opow_omega0_le_of_mul_eq_right {a b : Ordinal} (hab : a * b = b) :
   484|    b = 0 ∨ a ^ ω ≤ b := by
   485|  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
   486|  · rw [ha, zero_opow omega0_ne_zero]
   487|    exact Or.inr (zero_le b)
   488|  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
   489|  intro hb
   490|  rw [← nfp_mul_one ha]
   491|  rw [← Ne, ← one_le_iff_ne_zero] at hb
   492|  exact nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone hb (le_of_eq hab)
   493|
   494|theorem mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd {a b : Ordinal} : a * b = b ↔ a ^ ω ∣ b := by
   495|  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
   496|  · rw [ha, zero_mul, zero_opow omega0_ne_zero, zero_dvd_iff]
   497|    exact eq_comm
   498|  refine ⟨fun hab => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
   499|  · rw [dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
   500|    rw [← div_add_mod b (a ^ ω), mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0,
   501|      add_left_cancel_iff] at hab
   502|    rcases eq_zero_or_opow_omega0_le_of_mul_eq_right hab with hab | hab
   503|    · exact hab
   504|    refine (not_lt_of_ge hab (mod_lt b (opow_ne_zero ω ?_))).elim
   505|    rwa [← pos_iff_ne_zero]
   506|  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
   507|  rw [hc, ← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]
   508|
   509|theorem mul_le_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd {a b : Ordinal} (ha : 0 < a) :
   510|    a * b ≤ b ↔ (a ^ ω) ∣ b := by
   511|  rw [← mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd]
   512|  exact (isNormal_mul_right ha).strictMono.le_apply.ge_iff_eq'
   513|
   514|theorem nfp_mul_opow_omega0_add {a c : Ordinal} (b) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
   515|    (hca : c ≤ a ^ ω) : nfp (a * ·) (a ^ ω * b + c) = a ^ ω * succ b := by
   516|  apply le_antisymm
   517|  · apply nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone
   518|    · rw [mul_succ]
   519|      gcongr
   520|    · dsimp only; rw [← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]
   521|  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ :=
   522|      mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd.1 (nfp_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha) (a ^ ω * b + c))
   523|    rw [hd]
   524|    apply mul_le_mul_right
   525|    have := le_nfp (a * ·) (a ^ ω * b + c)
   526|    rw [hd] at this
   527|    have := (add_lt_add_right hc (a ^ ω * b)).trans_le this
   528|    rw [add_zero, mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (opow_pos ω ha)] at this
   529|    rwa [succ_le_iff]
